title: The Least Amount the Collective Keeps on a Given-Up Protection Plan
content:
A Pass and Trip Protection plan rated on the value covered carries a least amount the collective keeps when
the plan is given up, measured as a share of the premium frozen on the plan.

1. Where the plan is priced on the value covered, the plan is given up after its free look period has run out
   and cover has run past the plan's waiting period, the least amount kept is 10.00 per cent of the premium
   frozen on the plan.
2. Where the plan is priced on the value covered, the plan is given up after its free look period has run out
   and cover has not run past the plan's waiting period, the least amount kept is half of that share — 5.00
   per cent — of the premium frozen on the plan.
3. In every other case the least amount kept is nothing. A plan given up inside its free look period is one of
   those other cases, so nothing at all is kept on it on this ground.

**The two periods each plan carries.**

| Plan | Free look period (calendar days) | Waiting period (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | 10 | 14 |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | 14 | 10 |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | 14 | 7 |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | 14 | 10 |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | 21 | 7 |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | 30 | 0 |

**Reading the ladder.** Both of the first two require the plan to be rated on the value covered and to be
given up after its free look period has run out; between them the question is only whether cover has run past
the plan's waiting period. A plan rated flat falls to the third case whatever its dates, and so does any plan
given up inside its free look period.

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs).** On a plan rated on the value covered with 260.00 USD of premium
frozen on it, given up past its free look period with cover run past the waiting period, the least amount kept
is 26.00 USD; given up past its free look period with cover not yet run past the waiting period, it is 13.00
USD. On a plan rated flat, or on any plan given up inside its free look period, it is 0.00 USD.
